verify.description: Run the frontend verification loop: pnpm check, pnpm lint, pnpm build

args.description: Optional: subset to run (check, lint, build)

verify.prompt: Run the frontend verification loop from the frontend/ directory and report each result: 1) pnpm check, 2) pnpm lint, 3) pnpm build. All three must pass. If the user specified a subset, run only that part.

review.description: Run the reviewer subagent on the current diff against a task's acceptance criteria

args.description: Optional: kanban task ID whose card defines the acceptance criteria

review.prompt: Run the reviewer subagent on the current diff (uncommitted changes, plus the task branch if one exists), passing the task ID if one was given. The reviewer is read-only — it must not edit anything. Then save its report to docs/reviews/<task-id>.md (use docs/reviews/unpinned.md when no task ID was given). If the disposition is fix or rework, address the gaps in a follow-up pass and re-review before reporting done.
